causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: Network outages were the dominant contributing factor to the Victorian price outcomes.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Some Victorian generators rebid capacity from low to high prices and a number, that were directly affected by the constraint managing the possible line losses, rebid to reduce their ramp down rates.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: The main contributing factor for the high prices in South Australia was rebidding of capacity at Torrens Island by AGL from low to high prices, at the time when the network was constrained, setting the price.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: These reduced ramp rates prolonged the high price period.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: These constraints forced counter-price flows, from Victoria (high priced region) into New South Wales (low priced region), across the Vic-NSW interconnector, constrained down low-priced generation in Victoria and forced flows into Victoria from South Australia.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: In Victoria demand was slightly higher than forecast four hours ahead and up to 520 MW higher than forecast 12 hours ahead. However this was only a minor contributor to the high prices.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: These constraints forced counter-price flows, from Victoria (high priced region) into New South Wales (low priced region), across the Vic-NSW interconnector, constrained down low-priced generation in Victoria and forced flows into Victoria from South Australia.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink
interconnectors_named.quote: Both the Murraylink and Heywood interconnectors were exporting into Victoria at their limits.
